description: guest/ is its own Go module (go-virtio/validate#6): its tamago imports only compile for GOOS=tamago, so the organisation's gomodTidy post-update step, run on a host, would strip the go.sum entries the guest build needs. postUpdateOptions above therefore drops gomodTidy for this repository; CI checks tidiness instead (host tidy for the root and vtest modules, tamago-toolchain tidy for guest/). Guest updates get their own branch so a tidy drift in one never blocks the other.
